history.p: Gade composed his Sextet in two versions - an early version and the final version. There is no autograph score of the final version, but the revisions of the second, third and fourth movements were entered in the early score.

titleStmt.title: Score, autograph, draft and fair copy

physDesc.physMedium: 1 bifolio and 1 single folio paginated 2-6 with title page in blue crayon and "Andante" written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. 6 bifolios paginated 1-24. Heading on p. 1: "Sextett". On pp. 1-12 "Allegro vivace" end-dated "d. 16 Mai /63." and Gade's musical signature; on pp. 13-16 "Andantino", p. 16 beeing a single folio sewed on to the verso of p. 15; pp. 17-24 "Scherzo" end-dated "1863" and Gade's musical signature, followed by 1 single folio and 3 bifolios paginated 25-38. Page 25 a sketch; on pp. 26-27 "Larghetto" (not in the printed version) and on pp. 28-38 "Finale". End-dated "Fine / Sommer 1863." and Gade's musical signature.
